description: This Java class defines a Spring service handler for processing delete commands for standing instructions in the Fineract core banking system. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and delegates the delete operation to the StandingInstructionWritePlatformService.

classes.name: DeleteStandingInstructionCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service that handles delete commands for standing instructions, annotated with @CommandType and implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface. It uses dependency injection to obtain the service responsible for deletion.

methods.name: DeleteStandingInstructionCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the StandingInstructionWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete command by invoking the delete method on the StandingInstructionWritePlatformService with the entity ID from the command.
